entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Heart, pulse, blood; Chest, head, brow, scalp, sweat
entries.zh: 心脏、脉搏、血液；胸腔、头、额头、头皮、汗水。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 平静、感激。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Eased, slowed, calmed, released; Tingled, prickled, ached
entries.zh: 缓解、减慢、平静下来、释放；发麻、刺痒、疼痛。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 胸腔里猛烈的心跳逐渐平缓

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 呼吸慢下来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rapid beat of her heart became calmer
entries.zh: 急促的心跳渐渐平稳

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 如释重负时头皮一阵发麻

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 额头的汗干了

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 血液在全身涌动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Released the tension in her body
entries.zh: 释放身体里的紧张

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 为自己侥幸脱险而庆幸

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She began to calm down and her heart started to slow, but the panic had left an ache in her head and a ringing in her ears.
entries.zh: 她开始冷静，心跳也放慢，但恐慌留下了头疼和耳鸣。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Slowly, the pounding eased in her chest and the sweat dried on her brow.
entries.zh: 慢慢地，她胸口的猛跳平缓下来，额头上的汗也干了。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She could feel the blood surging round her body and releasing the tension.
entries.zh: 她能感觉到血液流遍全身，紧张也随之释放。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her breathing grew slower, as a new calm settled over her.
entries.zh: 她的呼吸慢下来，一种新的平静笼罩着她。

sections.title: Section 2 – Expressions, Eyes, Voice and Movement

entries.label: Nouns
entries.zh: 脸颊、眼睛、肩膀、叹息。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 苍白、发自内心的。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 鼓起后呼气、发出；闭上、放低、放松。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 鼓起脸颊，长长呼出气

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 闭上眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 放下紧绷的双肩

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 发出由衷的叹息

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Slowly, the rapid beat of her heart became calmer and her pale face relaxed, as the tension in her body eased.
entries.zh: 随着身体不再紧绷，她急促的心跳慢慢平稳，苍白的面容也舒展开来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She blew out her cheeks and closed her eyes, hardly daring to believe that she had escaped without any injuries.
entries.zh: 她鼓着脸颊呼出一口气，闭上眼睛，几乎不敢相信自己毫发无伤地逃了出来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the tension left her body, she lowered her shoulders and uttered a heartfelt sigh.
entries.zh: 身体的紧张消散后，她放下双肩，发出一声由衷的长叹。
